name: Agent ID Hackathon entries ranked by on-chain use (fixed method)
method: Public GitHub hackathon entries that name BNB Chain mainnet contracts (list built 21-22 Nov 2026 from GitHub search; 312 contracts). Every log those contracts emitted from the contest start to the cut-off block, read with eth_getLogs. Transactions = distinct transaction hashes with at least one such log. Minting wallets = distinct recipients of a Transfer from the zero address. The ERC-8004 and Agent ID registries and other shared infrastructure are left out. Re-run daily; anyone can repeat it.

ours.note: Ranks use our numbers without the builder's own wallet (its settle, claim and ticket calls).

limits: Entries without a public GitHub repository, or whose contracts are not named in it, are not in this list. A transaction that emits no log is not counted, for any entry.
